propositions: Noun-based bridge operations (preview, sync, status, pause, resume, check_access) must be added to the public library API and MCP tool surface in parallel with the CLI
Legacy rebar.reconcile(mode=...) and bridge_fsck() must remain functional with unchanged defaults, signatures, return values, and exception behavior as compatibility entrypoints
A shared typed result-bearing helper must be extracted beneath run_pass() and reused by new library/MCP adapters instead of duplicating the reconciler or invoking the CLI

MCP mutating operations (bridge_sync, bridge_pause, bridge_resume, and legacy reconcile mutating modes) must be gated by mcp.allow_jira_sync; preview, status, fsck, and access-check reads must not be gated by it
Every new structured-result MCP tool must publish an outputSchema and maintain parity between MCP models, public result types, and generated schema references

Compatibility tests must prove that legacy library/MCP reconcile modes produce identical semantic state and mutation outcomes as their mapped new bridge operations while retaining distinct published contracts
